scope: Real fixed-network backend responses and production-gate mutations; logical reserve slots, not CPU/energy capacity
limits: All roles and backends share one UID and a trusted parent
No trained LLM, human subject or physical life support
No throughput claims; capacity is a preassigned per-demand slot contract
After-commit measurements not used to repair within-round decisions
Unmediated-bypass and false-sensor trials deliberately break certificate premises
Three actual processes are reused across configurations, not 86 independent populations
